## 1. Purpose

Sets discount approval authority for direct enterprise sales for calendar 2025.

## 2. Effective period

This policy is effective from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

## 3. Approval authority

- Enterprise Account Executives may approve discounts up to and including 15%.

## 4. Rules

- Discounts must be calculated against the current list price.
- Contract-specific pricing exceptions must be reviewed.

**Why she could approve it on 2025-09-23**
- **Policy in force:** Northstar Pricing Policy 2025 ran from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. It lets Enterprise Account Executives approve discounts "up to and including 15%". Only discounts above 15% needed VP Sales.
- **Her role:** The employee records and org chart list her as Enterprise Account Executive (reporting to Michael Torres, VP Sales). She is also the owner of the Acme account (CRM-2048). One caveat: these records are dated 2026 and I found no dated history of her role, so I'm assuming she held the same title in September 2025.
- **Contract:** The Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) ran from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31 and covers the NS-500.
- **Pricing exception:** EXC-ACME-NS500-15 allows Acme up to 15% off list price on the NS-500 only, from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. It replaced the earlier 10% exception. The exception only makes Acme eligible for the discount; it doesn't give anyone authority to approve it. In 2025, her authority came from the pricing policy.
- **What actually happened:** She did approve one herself: DR-8104, 15% off a $250,000 NS-500 order, requested and approved by her on 2025-09-16. Her 2026 email calls this "what we did for them last September."

**Why she can't approve DR-9001 (2026-09-23)**
- The Approval Authority Matrix for 2026 now limits Enterprise Account Executives to **10% or less**. Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the **VP Sales**, and they must be recorded in Northstar CRM.
- Acme is still eligible for 15% under the exception, but approval has to come from Michael Torres. DR-9001 is currently "Pending Approval".
